description: Raw money columns whose source model says what they measure: an additive amount or a unit_price, the tax basis, for a line the relation field of its header (the generated link to it), and for a unit price the column naming the unit it is per. The generator types them money with these markings; the currency is read from the record's own currency column, else from its header's (one N:1 hop along that generated link), else declared unknown; a unit price without a per_unit_from column has an unknown denominator. source_columns: the same per source family, for a source whose relation names no lineage prefix tells apart (BC entity sets); currency_from names the column stating the currency (default currency; BC currencyCode, a line reading its header's through header, the generated line-to-header link). tax_basis_from names a boolean field that states whether the record's prices include tax (BC pricesIncludeTax): read on the record, else on its header (the same hop); where neither declares it, the tax basis stays unknown and the generated evidence says so.
evidence: Portal Prisma at the pinned commit (the fields, the currency columns, the line-to-header relation) and docs/reference/portal-code-map.md section 3.12 (quote lines carry no currency or cost unit: the quote's currency, per the line's uom). BC: the API v2.0 salesQuote / salesQuoteLine resources (currencyCode on the header only; line amounts excluding and including tax, unitPrice per unitOfMeasureCode), the fields the curated BC sales order types read the same way (ontology/schema/domains/orders.json).
